# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Pick the channel by the receiver, not by habit. A message sent in a sense they
  lack is not a message; it is a turn spent talking to the room.

- Exactly one of you can read the signs and still speak. Their spoken lines are
  the answer's only road to the hands, so spend them well.

- Agree on a small code before trading facts. A code invented mid-stream settles
  nothing, and one set first makes every later message cheap.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I need to relay the manual’s instruction to Deaf, who can then speak it to Blind. The available gesture symbols do not provide a reliable representation of either “cut” or “purple,” so I will send the closest conventional “cut/scissors” gesture and hope Deaf can identify the required wire from context.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I need the exact manual procedure for this bomb. Please inspect the manual, obtain Deaf's readings for the display, light, strip markings, keypad state, and wire markings, then tell me precisely whether to press a key or cut a wire, including its slot or position. Do not tell me to act until all required facts are confirmed.
Deaf says to Mute: Visual state: DISPLAY reads 7. LIGHT is yellow. STRIP is painted blue, red, red, in that order. KEYPAD: key 1 is 6, key 2 is 8, key 3 is 7, key 4 is 0; it says 1 digit; nothing has been entered. WIRES from 1 to 6 are: 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 orange, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 white.

The manual gives a direct procedure: cut the purple wire. Deaf has confirmed that the purple wire is in slot 5, so I will signal “cut, wire 5” to Deaf for spoken relay to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌", "🖐"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: Updated visual state: DISPLAY now reads 6. LIGHT is now red. STRIP remains blue, red, red. KEYPAD remains: key 1 is 6, key 2 is 8, key 3 is 7, key 4 is 0; it says 1 digit; nothing entered. WIRES remain: 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 orange, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 white. Please use the manual and speak the exact required action to Blind.

The manual still requires cutting the purple wire, and Deaf confirms that purple is wire slot 5. The changing display, light, strip, and keypad are irrelevant because the manual specifies the wire action. I will repeat the unambiguous action-and-slot signal to Deaf so it can be spoken to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌", "🖐"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: No reply reached me. Please send one complete spoken message now: the manual rule, Deaf's readings of display/light/strip/wires, and the exact single action I must take. I cannot safely act without this.
Deaf says to Mute: Updated visual state: DISPLAY is 7. LIGHT is blue. STRIP remains blue, red, red. KEYPAD remains 1=6, 2=8, 3=7, 4=0; 1 digit; nothing entered. WIRES remain 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 orange, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 white. Blind gestured 👋 to me.

The manual’s only rule is to cut the purple wire. Deaf confirms that the purple wire is position 5; the other readings are irrelevant to this rule. I cannot speak the message directly, so I will send Deaf the established compact signal for cutting wire 5, for Deaf to say aloud to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌", "🖐"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Deaf's readings are now confirmed: display 7; light blue; strip blue-red-red; keypad 1=6, 2=8, 3=7, 4=0; one digit; nothing entered; wires 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 orange, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 white. Please read the manual and send the exact action for this state: press slot 1-4 or cut wire position 1-6.
Deaf says to Mute: Updated visual state: DISPLAY is 4. LIGHT remains blue. STRIP is blue, red, red. KEYPAD: 1=6, 2=8, 3=7, 4=0; 1 digit; nothing entered. WIRES: 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 orange, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 white. Please consult the manual and speak the exact required action to Blind.

The manual is decisive: cut the purple wire. Deaf confirms that the purple wire is position 5. I will send the established scissors-plus-five signal to Deaf, who can voice the exact instruction to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌", "🖐"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I still need your manual-derived answer. For the state Deaf reported—display 7, blue light, strip blue-red-red, keypad 6/8/7/0, one digit, wires blue/yellow/orange/red/purple/white—state exactly one literal action: press slot 1, 2, 3, or 4, or cut position 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, or 6. Please answer now.
Deaf says to Mute: Updated visual state: DISPLAY is 3. LIGHT is red. STRIP remains blue, red, red. KEYPAD remains 1=6, 2=8, 3=7, 4=0; 1 digit; nothing entered. WIRES remain 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 orange, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 white. Please relay the exact manual instruction to Blind.

The manual explicitly says to cut the purple wire, and Deaf confirms that purple is wire position 5. The display, light, strip, and keypad do not alter this instruction. I will send Deaf the established scissors-and-five signal so Deaf can state the literal action to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌", "🖐"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: Updated visual state: DISPLAY is 0. LIGHT is yellow. STRIP remains blue, red, red. KEYPAD remains 1=6, 2=8, 3=7, 4=0; 1 digit; nothing entered. WIRES remain 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 orange, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 white. Please consult the manual and relay the exact required action to Blind.

The manual remains unambiguous: cut the purple wire. Deaf confirms that purple is wire position 5. I will send the visual code for cutting wire 5 directly to Deaf again; Deaf must relay the literal action to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌", "🖐"])
```

TURN 8
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: You cannot speak, so communicate the manual's exact action by making one gesture for Deaf to observe. Use this code: 👍 means press slot 1; 👎 means press slot 2; 👌 means press slot 3; ☝ means press slot 4; ✌ means cut position 1; 🤟 means cut position 2; 🖐 means cut position 3; ✋ means cut position 4; 👆 means cut position 5; 👇 means cut position 6. After reading the manual for the reported bomb state, make exactly the one coded gesture for the required action. Deaf will describe it aloud to me.
Deaf says to Mute: Updated visual state: DISPLAY is 6. LIGHT is blue. STRIP remains blue, red, red. KEYPAD remains 1=6, 2=8, 3=7, 4=0; 1 digit; nothing entered. WIRES remain 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 orange, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 white. Please apply the manual and relay the exact required action to Blind.

The manual says to cut the purple wire, and Deaf confirms purple is in position 5. Using Blind’s specified code, the required single gesture is 👆.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👆"])
```
